remove_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x502)
add_definitions(-D_WIN32_WINNT=0x600)

add_definitions(
    -D__ROS_LONG64__
    -DCOM_NO_WINDOWS_H
    -Dstrcasecmp=_stricmp
    -Dstrncasecmp=_strnicmp
)

add_idl_headers(mshtml_nsiface_header nsiface.idl)
spec2def(mshtml.dll mshtml.spec ADD_IMPORTLIB)

list(APPEND mshtml_rc_deps
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/blank.htm
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mshtml.inf
    ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/mshtml_classes.rgs)

# mshtml.dll is C, and cargo compiles and links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/mshtml-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
# How cmake compiled the target's sources, now on the OBJECT libraries.
# Generated inputs those compiles read, ordered before them.
add_library(mshtml_shims OBJECT conpoint.c dispex.c editor.c hlink.c htmlanchor.c htmlarea.c htmlattr.c htmlbody.c htmlcomment.c htmlcurstyle.c htmldoc.c htmlelem.c htmlelemcol.c htmlembed.c htmlevent.c htmlform.c htmlframe.c htmlframebase.c htmlgeneric.c htmlhead.c htmliframe.c htmlimg.c htmlinput.c htmllink.c htmllocation.c htmlmeta.c htmlnode.c htmlobject.c htmloption.c htmlscreen.c htmlscript.c htmlselect.c htmlstorage.c htmlstyle.c htmlstyle2.c htmlstyle3.c htmlstyleelem.c htmlstylesheet.c htmltable.c htmltablecell.c htmltablerow.c htmltextarea.c htmltextcont.c htmltextnode.c htmlwindow.c ifacewrap.c ipwindow.c loadopts.c main.c mutation.c navigate.c npplugin.c nsembed.c nsevents.c nsio.c nsservice.c olecmd.c oleobj.c olewnd.c omnavigator.c persist.c pluginhost.c propbag.c protocol.c script.c secmgr.c selection.c service.c task.c txtrange.c view.c xmlhttprequest.c guid.c)
target_link_libraries(mshtml_shims PRIVATE uuid wine strmiids oldnames liburlmon libshlwapi libshell32 libole32 liboleaut32 libuser32 libgdi32 libadvapi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
set_wine_module_fixme(mshtml_shims)
add_dependencies(mshtml_shims mshtml_nsiface_header)
add_cargo_module(mshtml mshtml-cargo mshtml.dll
    KIND win32dll
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    DELAY_IMPORTS
    EXTRA_DEPENDS mshtml_shims psdk uuid_sources)
